headline: Pampa Energia Stock Hits 52-Week Low at $69.32
summary: Shares of Pampa Energia reached a new 52-week low, trading at $69.32.
why: Pampa Energia is a leading Argentine integrated power company traded on international exchanges, serving as a key benchmark for the country's energy sector valuation.

impacts.why: Hitting a 52-week low reflects persistent selling pressure and negative investor sentiment toward the equity.
